indexes.name: Avalanche DEX Index
indexes.description:
🔄 Own the exchanges, not just the trades.

Every swap on Avalanche pays one of these four DEXs: Trader Joe (JOE), Pangolin (PNG), Pharaoh (PHAR) and Blackhole (BLACK). One token, the whole Avalanche trading floor.

📉 The insight: at launch (Nov 2026) DEX tokens were down 28–50% over 30 days while AVAX itself still trades $38M a day on-chain. Activity stayed, prices fell. This basket is a bet that the gap closes.

⚖️ JOE leads at 30% as the oldest venue; PNG and PHAR 25% each; BLACK 20% as the newcomer. Auto-rebalances when any leg drifts 20%.

⚠️ Small-cap DeFi tokens: expect big swings both ways.

indexes.name: Avalanche Blue Chips
indexes.description:
💎 The five assets that carry Avalanche DeFi.

AVAX, bridged Bitcoin and Ether, staked AVAX and Chainlink: together they make up most of the volume on Avalanche DEXs. These are the coins the rest of the ecosystem is priced against.

📊 The insight: AVAX, BTC.b and WETH.e are the top three by 24h on-chain volume ($38M, $13M and $12M at launch). Deep liquidity means low slippage when you buy, sell or rebalance.

🧱 AVAX anchors at 35%, BTC.b 25%, WETH.e 20%; sAVAX adds staking yield (10%) and LINK.e the oracle layer (10%).

🛡️ The steady core of an Avalanche portfolio. Redeem for the five tokens any time.

indexes.name: Avalanche Meme Arena
indexes.description:
🐸🔥 Avalanche memes in one ticket.

COQ, KIMBO, NOCHILL, ARENA and NYA: the culture coins of the C-Chain. Picking one winner is a lottery; holding the whole arena is a theme.

🎢 The insight: every token here lost 23–34% over 30 days at launch, moving almost together. When sentiment on Avalanche turns, memes tend to move first and furthest. This basket lets you ride that without betting on a single ticker.

🎯 COQ leads at 25% as the largest; the rest 15–20%. The creator updates weights by hand when the meme meta shifts.

☠️ Highest-risk index on Pantado. Only money you can lose.

indexes.name: Avalanche DeFi Core
indexes.description:
🏦 The money markets of Avalanche.

BENQI (QI), Aave (AAVE.e) and Folks Finance (FOLKS) run lending and borrowing on the C-Chain; sAVAX is the liquid-staking collateral they all accept; Chainlink (LINK.e) feeds their prices.

🔍 The insight: FOLKS was one of the few DeFi tokens up over 30 days (+3.7%) at launch while QI fell 37% and AAVE.e 29%. Spreading across protocols keeps one protocol's bad month from sinking the basket.

⚙️ 25% QI, 25% AAVE.e, 20% FOLKS, 20% sAVAX, 10% LINK.e. Auto-rebalances on 20% drift.

📚 A protocol-diversified DeFi position in one token.

indexes.name: Digital Gold Hedge
indexes.description:
🥇₿ Old gold, new gold, and cash.

Tokenized gold (XAUt0), Bitcoin (BTC.b) and two stablecoins (USDt, EURC): a defensive basket for rough markets, all on Avalanche.

🧭 The insight: over the 30 days before launch, gold token XAUt0 fell only 7.5% while BTC.b fell 20% and AVAX 27%. The stablecoins held their peg. Mixing them softens drawdowns versus holding crypto alone.

⚖️ 40% gold, 30% Bitcoin, 15% dollar, 15% euro. Tight auto-rebalance (10% drift) keeps the hedge in shape.

🌙 For when you want to stay on-chain but sleep at night.

indexes.name: Wall Street x Avalanche
indexes.description:
🏛️⛓️ Stocks, Bitcoin, gold and AVAX in one token.

NVIDIA, Apple and Coinbase as tokenized stocks, next to BTC.b, AVAX and tokenized gold. The real-world assets your brokerage holds and the crypto it does not, in a single basket you can redeem in kind.

🌐 The insight: tokenized stocks now trade on-chain around the clock. Pairing them with crypto lets one index hold assets that usually live in two separate accounts.

📐 NVDA 20%, AAPL 15%, COIN 15%, BTC.b 20%, AVAX 20%, gold 10%.

🧪 Stock prices come from Robinhood Chain until permissionless stock pools launch on Avalanche.
